blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Sorting puts items in order. Simple sorts compare and move items in nested loops and cost $n^2$. Merge sort splits, sorts the halves and merges, which costs $n \log n$.

blocks.title: Insertion sort
Merge two sorted arrays
Stability
items: Stable: equal items keep their original order
Selection sort can reorder equal items

blocks.body: For small arrays any simple sort is fine. For large arrays choose an $n \log n$ sort.
